site_name: Blyth Energy Central / Blyth Tax Site
evidence_slice: Northumberland County Council publishes the Investment Zones dataset as an official public ArcGIS FeatureServer with layer 0, British National Grid EPSG:27700, and WFS/OGC API feature distributions. The dataset was updated 20 August 2026 and is licensed under the UK Open Government Licence. HM Revenue & Customs identifies Blyth as a North East Investment Zone tax site, and the Designation of Special Tax Sites (Liverpool City Region, West Midlands and North East Investment Zones) Regulations 2024 designate the area shown on the map entitled 'Blyth Tax Site', dated 26 January 2024, with effect from 8 April 2024.

field_evidence.legal_instrument: The Designation of Special Tax Sites (Liverpool City Region, West Midlands and North East Investment Zones) Regulations 2024 (SI 2024/383)
